scope: Prioritized bounded investigations; OPEN is unfinished static work, BLOCKED requires unavailable runtime. No claim of exhaustive unknowns.

questions.title: Remaining Settings effect chains
questions.known_boundary: Many XML controls have declarations, typed registration and candidate field references, but no proven end-to-end consumer/apply chain.
questions.source_targets: settings-registry.json rows without effect_trace_refs; page_helpers in settings-persistence-map.json
questions.next_investigation: Trace helpers, listener discriminators, typed wrappers and actual consumers; use smali when Java branches are damaged.
questions.implementation_impact: Blocks a claim of complete configurable parity; not schema architecture.

questions.title: Original Android runtime validation
questions.known_boundary: No Android runtime or connected phone; zero runtime-confirmed records.
questions.next_investigation: Run original build across explicit configurations and event sequences, recording API, density, font scale, insets and capability inputs. No owner export is required.

questions.title: Grouped reorder and mutation races
questions.known_boundary: Grouped selection packing, crossover geometry, provider failures and concurrent replacement are not fully resolved.
questions.source_targets: kw0.А/y/X, iw0.В, bi1.р, x8, yf0.K, om0.m0
questions.next_investigation: Trace remaining bytecode around candidate map and data callback ownership; verify reversal/cancel during asynchronous reload.

questions.title: Output hardware initialization
questions.known_boundary: j30 constructor/profile initialization/runtime request are distinct; entire vendor/device matrix is not normalized.
questions.next_investigation: Trace each capability and initialization branch into structured conditional defaults; keep native support queries external.
questions.implementation_impact: Blocks universal audio option/default parity; UI interface contracts are available.

questions.title: Search and library asynchronous history
questions.known_boundary: Entry/history ownership is mapped; old-result replacement, loader coalescing and some transition precedence remain bounded.
questions.next_investigation: Follow request generation, completion and history updates through worker/bus boundaries.
questions.implementation_impact: Needed before claiming race-safe complete navigation.

questions.title: Native final geometry and text
questions.known_boundary: Resolved resources do not supply Android glyph metrics or every state rectangle.
questions.source_targets: FastLayout/r40; FastTextView; AAItemView; SceneParams/do1; Android Paint
questions.next_investigation: Complete remaining measure/layout branches and obtain actual font/shape metrics; compare selected native configurations.
questions.implementation_impact: Blocks final pixel parity; effective style resolver is usable.

questions.title: Notification renderer variants
questions.known_boundary: Renderer selection and API/vendor gates are traced, not all renderer output and media-host behavior.
questions.source_targets: py0 and alternate notification implementations; ui_notify helper
questions.next_investigation: Trace each renderer and PendingIntent/state path, then validate platform host behavior.

questions.title: Widget host and preview lifecycle
questions.known_boundary: Widget configuration/control contract is bounded; host sizing, preview races and every RemoteViews state are not observed.
questions.source_targets: BaseWidgetConfigureActivity; da2/ia2; widget providers; RemoteViews callbacks
questions.next_investigation: Trace per-size visibility and update paths; validate host resizing, artwork load and process restart.
questions.implementation_impact: Needed for widgets beyond reusable configuration architecture.

questions.title: Unproven resource-only button editor
questions.known_boundary: An EQ button-editor layout/style exists without proven installation/entry.
questions.next_investigation: Find actual loader/consumer and eligible class, or document dormant resource with bounded negative search.
questions.implementation_impact: Do not invent a reachable screen.

questions.title: Bit-perfect warning cancellation
questions.known_boundary: Listener returns true while confirmation requests reload; checked/saved state may survive cancel.
questions.next_investigation: Verify listener/state sequence and original Android cancellation behavior.
questions.implementation_impact: Blocks reproducing this exact interaction edge.

questions.title: Short crossfade immediate apply
questions.known_boundary: Consumer reads saved fade_short_xfade_ms but equivalent page listener is absent.
questions.next_investigation: Locate another observer/lifecycle application route or confirm deferred effect.

questions.title: Secondary graphic precision
questions.known_boundary: Response sampling is known; full miniature reduction, alphabet transitions, search highlighting and preview rounding remain bounded.
questions.source_targets: rendering-components.json uncertainties; FrequencyResponseScroller/MilkFRS; native rendering interfaces
questions.next_investigation: Trace the smallest named Java/smali/native functions; avoid full DSP reverse engineering.

questions.title: All migration histories and resets
questions.known_boundary: Fresh initialization and representative scoped resets are traced; not every upgrade path or named-store notification is proven.
questions.source_targets: Application.с; store x(version); o30/x30/p30; reset callbacks
questions.next_investigation: Model relevant previous-build states and test independent default/reset contracts.
questions.implementation_impact: Needed for historical import compatibility, not clean new architecture.

questions.title: External skins and plugins
questions.known_boundary: Built-in skin and plugin UI boundaries are mapped; arbitrary external packages and plugin behavior are not reconstructed.
questions.source_targets: SkinInfo/SkinManager; native output plugins; lyrics/visualizer interfaces
questions.next_investigation: Define supported interface subset from concrete external consumers before claiming compatibility.

questions.title: Import/export archive interoperability
questions.known_boundary: Typed domain rows are traced; original archive wrapper not examined.
questions.source_targets: Settings import/export helpers and native archive boundary
questions.next_investigation: Inspect archive format only if interoperability becomes an explicit implementation requirement.
questions.implementation_impact: Does not justify requesting owner settings.

questions.title: Startup/SDK conditional screens
questions.known_boundary: Some manifest activities have proven construction but unproved app-level guard/route.
questions.source_targets: screen-registry.json OPEN entries; Welcome/Expired; SDK conditional families
questions.next_investigation: Trace only app-level construction/entry conditions; leave license enforcement and third-party service internals out of scope.
questions.implementation_impact: Inventory is complete for enumerated manifest/factories, not every runtime condition.
